chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when a yellow, red, or black wind blew, his face would change, his color would turn pale, and he would be like one fearful and anxious, until a drop of rain fell from the sky; then his color would return to him, and he would say:
It has come to you with mercy.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَةِ: mercy, indicating the rain’s gracious divine significance
key_terms.الْخَائِفِ: fearful, describing the Prophet’s visible state
key_terms.رِيحٌ: wind, a natural sign associated here with apprehension before rain
key_terms.سَوْدَاءُ: black, describing one kind of wind mentioned in the report
key_terms.صَفْرَاءُ: yellow, describing one kind of wind mentioned in the report
key_terms.قَطْرَةٌ: a drop, specifically a drop of rain from the sky

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم respond when strong colored winds blew before rain?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would become visibly concerned when ominous winds appeared, reflecting reverence and fear before divine signs. When rain began to fall, he would recognize it as a manifestation of rahmah, saying that it had come with mercy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1525 - When a yellow, red, or black wind would blow, the Prophet (sw) would become visibly changed—his face would turn pale, and his color would change as if he were fearful and anxious.
He would remain in this state until a drop of rain fell from the sky, at which point his color would return, and he would say,
'It has come to you with mercy.'
